digest.component_or_area: store push and init with S3 remotes
propositions: An s3:// or s3+zip:// ticket remote without a valid git-remote-s3 helper (version >=0.3.2) can silently corrupt the store by creating multiple bundles for one ref.
Store init and synchronous push paths must detect S3 mode by remote URL scheme and call require_s3_helper() to fail closed with an actionable error before any push attempt.

The S3 preflight must raise OptionalDependencyError unconditionally, independent of push_tickets_branch's best-effort strict flag, so it propagates through write_and_push and is re-raised in push_after_commit to prevent silent corruption.
The preflight helper _require_s3_helper_if_s3_url() must reuse already-resolved remote URLs (from existing git remote get-url calls) and remain a no-op for non-S3 schemes.
With a non-S3 remote or an unresolvable remote, the preflight must be a no-op and existing best-effort behavior (including remote-not-found skip) must be preserved.
Fail-closed behavior must be verified by CLI subprocess tests covering missing/too-old helper, both s3:// and s3+zip:// schemes, and non-S3 remote no-regressions.
